title: ALSU Uzbek population genetics
summary: Array and imputed genotypes of ~1,256 Uzbek individuals: PCA, ADMIXTURE, FST, relatedness, GWAS. Currently being re-checked against a corrected reference.
about: Population-genetics analysis of an Uzbek cohort, run on the DRAGEN server. Outputs are a public GitHub site (Toki-bio/ALSU-analysis), a Russian-language report and a slide deck. In October 2026 the PBS selection candidates were found to come from errors in the 1000G GRCh38 call set, so the analysis is being redone on the NYGC 30x reference.

title: Sicista betulina genome
summary: ONT assembly of the northern birch mouse (primary: 2.99 Gb, N50 18.25 Mb, BUSCO 99.2%), plus mitogenome/NUMT findings and a first SINE scan.
about: Assembly of S. betulina (individual ZBS2026-Sb1, Bannikova lab ONT, about 104 Gb) on therioserver. Collaborators: Kim Cooper (UCSD), Michael Hiller (Senckenberg, will run TOGA2), Anna Bannikova, Vladimir Lebedev. Side questions: whether extra Illumina is needed, and why PCR fails (a ~200-copy nuclear lineage-B mtDNA-like family was found).
where: Gene BEDs and SINE cards: C:\work\Tal\sicista
plan: Evaluate the primary assembly (earlier numbers were hap1) and recommend it
Share primary assembly and raw reads with the Hiller lab
QC verdict: no extra Illumina needed on this individual (male, 35x ONT)
Mitogenome / NUMT analysis
Check the lab's actual PCR primers against the lineage-B family and the control-region repeat
Finish de novo SINE scan, Dip SINEderella, and orthologous loci vs S. trizona
More individuals for MSMC and population SINE frequencies
Request pod5 and metadata from the sequencing company
log: ONT-only PSMC and SINE-indel feasibility tests: robust above 60 ky, 25,313 heterozygous SINE-like indels on autosomes. Verdict: extra Illumina not needed on this individual.
Mito/NUMT study: real mtDNA is circular with a 312 bp ATACGC x52 control-region repeat; nuclear genome holds a ~200-copy lineage-B-type family. Unattended SINE scan launched on both genomes.
Audit found all earlier quoted numbers were hap1; the primary (1,144 contigs, N50 18.25 Mb, BUSCO 99.2%) is better on both metrics.

title: Tropiocolotes 5-locus alignments
summary: Supplied Tropiocolotes sequences (12S, 16S, CYTB, MC1R, c-mos) merged with a GenBank snapshot and aligned with MAFFT. Stops at alignments.
about: 20 supplied samples (CN10xxx, 13-19 sequences per locus, none yet in GenBank under those IDs) were put in context with a GenBank text-query snapshot of 2025-10-11 (includes 7 Trachydactylus/Bunopus records), one alignment per locus. The 12S, 16S and CYTB alignments are about 20,500 columns wide because two complete mitogenomes (AB738944, AB661661) are in every query result; trim before any tree. CMOS and MC1R alignments were re-run on 2026-10-04 and reproduce byte for byte. No tree or other analysis exists in the folder or the shell history. Reference paper: Machado et al. 2018.
where: KIT: /data/W/toki/Tropiocolotes_5loci_2025-10 (21 files, 11 MB; README.md = full description, MD5SUMS.txt). Only copy of the KIT data; no other backup by decision.

title: LF-SINE project: crocodilians (first folder)
summary: Repbase crocodilian SINEs and three LF-SINE queries searched in the gharial and the American alligator genomes; crocodilian arm of the LF-SINE-in-birds work.
about: 2024-01: 25 Repbase crocodilian SINE consensi searched in Gavialis gangeticus (rGavGan2 hap2) and clustered; a RepeatModeler attempt failed immediately (missing RepeatMasker module) and left 2.3 GB of leftovers. 2024-07: lfsine.q, LFSINE-rb.q and lfsine_mid.q searched in the gharial and Alligator mississippiensis (rAllMis1): 1,657 / 979 / 308 hits in the gharial, 1,788 / 1,032 / 315 in the alligator; hits clustered into 34 groups. Same queries were used on emu, kiwi and other birds the same days. No written conclusion. This is the first audited folder of the LF-SINE project, searched or planned in birds (moa), humans, sharks and relatives, lungfishes; publication-bound.
where: Candidate LF-SINE folders on KIT (not examined yet): moa (birds, coelacanth), Genomes/Fish/Lungfish, Genomes/lower/Chondrichthyes, hsa (humans), Lagomorpha, amphibians
plan: Crocodilia folder audited and tidied (queries, gharial, alligator, Repbase SINEs)
